_comment: The v1.9 acceptance backbone (charter SLO table). Every number here is either MEASURED (with its evidence file) or explicitly unmeasured with its venue named. tools/budget_check.py asserts the measurable ones and fails CI/soak on regression — a budget without an enforcer is a wish.

verify_verdict_p95_s_minspec.venue: field Diagnose zip on the pilot 4-core box (v1.8.9+)
